_comment: 地圖頁的雙語文字：分類、在地導覽（改寫自官方試算表的 Intro 分頁）、注意區域。注意區域的位置取自 data-src/safety.json 最密集的幾群格子，說明是本站自己寫的，不是 COLM 官方建議。

further.zh: 較遠的公園、博物館與步道

text.en: The Hilton sits on the border between Union Square and the Tenderloin, a neighborhood with high levels of homelessness that is the locus of the city's fentanyl crisis — and also a rich cultural district with the theater district, vibrant bars, historic LGBTQ+ activism and incredible late-night food. Take common-sense precautions and visit with compassion.
text.zh: Hilton 位在 Union Square 與 Tenderloin 的交界。Tenderloin 遊民很多，也是舊金山芬太尼危機的中心；但它同時是文化豐富的街區：劇院區、熱鬧的酒吧、LGBTQ+ 運動的歷史現場，還有很棒的宵夜。請保持基本警覺，也請帶著同理心走訪。

text.en: Powell Street station, a short walk away, serves Muni Metro (T to Chinatown; J K L M N S to the Ferry Building; K L M S to the Castro) and BART (Ferry Building, the Mission, Berkeley, Oakland). Tap a credit card on every Muni vehicle, cable cars included, and on BART — tap the same card again to exit. The historic F streetcar runs along Market Street to the Ferry Building and the Castro.
text.zh: 走路就到的 Powell Street 站有 Muni Metro（T 線到中國城；J、K、L、M、N、S 到 Ferry Building；K、L、M、S 到 Castro）與 BART（Ferry Building、Mission、Berkeley、Oakland）。所有 Muni 車輛（含叮噹車）和 BART 都能直接感應信用卡；BART 出站要再感應同一張卡。Market Street 上的 F 線復古路面電車可到 Ferry Building 和 Castro。

text.en: The official list picks places within a 20-minute walk, or one 20-minute ride on BART, Muni or a cable car with no transfers. San Francisco is a compact 7×7-mile city that rewards walking — there is far more than fits on any list, so go explore.
text.zh: 官方清單挑的是走路 20 分鐘內、或搭一趟 BART／Muni／叮噹車 20 分鐘內（不用轉乘）到得了的地方。舊金山只有 7×7 英里，很適合散步；清單只是一小部分，歡迎自己去探索。

note.en: Eddy, Turk, Ellis and Golden Gate between Jones and Larkin — open-air drug use and dealing, and the densest cluster of assaults near the venue. Walking through by day is common; avoid lingering, especially after dark. Heading north or east from the Hilton (Geary → Powell) keeps you out of it.
note.zh: Eddy、Turk、Ellis、Golden Gate 這幾條街在 Jones 到 Larkin 之間的路段：露天用藥與毒品交易，也是會場附近傷害案最密集的一群。白天穿過去的人很多，但不要逗留，天黑後尤其注意。從 Hilton 往北或往東走（Geary → Powell）就不會經過。

note.en: The plaza and station entrances at Market & 7th–8th see heavy drug activity. If you take BART, Powell Street is the nicer station for the Hilton.
note.zh: Market 與 7th–8th 街口的廣場和車站出入口毒品活動很多。搭 BART 的話，到 Hilton 用 Powell Street 站比較好。

note.en: Among the densest blocks in the data. Walking from the Hilton to SoMa or the Moscone Center, use 4th or 5th Street instead.
note.zh: 以街廓來算是資料裡最密集的路段之一。從 Hilton 走去 SoMa 或 Moscone Center，改走 4th 或 5th Street。

note.en: The station plazas at 16th & Mission are one of the two hottest cells in the data (with 6th & Market). Fine to pass through on the way to Mission restaurants; don't hang around, and keep your phone away at night.
note.zh: 16th 與 Mission 街口的車站廣場是整份資料最熱的兩格之一（另一格是 6th 與 Market）。去 Mission 吃飯經過沒問題，但不要停留，晚上手機收好。

note.en: Busier and calmer than 16th St, but still a hotspot around the station plazas, especially late. La Taqueria and La Vaca Birria are a short walk away.
note.zh: 比 16th St 站熱鬧也平靜一些，但車站廣場周邊仍是熱點，深夜尤其如此。La Taqueria 和 La Vaca Birria 走幾步就到。

en: Main streets are busy and generally fine by day; the heat shows where incidents are reported, not where you will be harmed.
After dark, prefer lit main streets or a rideshare for longer walks, and keep your phone out of reach of passing hands.
Car break-ins are very common — never leave anything visible in a car (they are not counted in this map).
zh: 白天主要街道人很多，大致沒問題；熱區代表「事件被通報的地方」，不等於你一定會遇到危險。
天黑後盡量走有路燈的主要街道，距離長就叫車；手機別拿在路過的人伸手就搶得到的地方。
車窗被砸偷東西非常常見 —— 車上不要留任何看得到的物品（這類案件沒算進這張地圖）。
